name: pr-inbox
description: An inbox for review requests (oldest first, with AI summary, risk and release impact) and your own PRs (what needs action first), with explain and approve from the pane

org_filter.title: Organization
org_filter.description: Only show PRs in this GitHub organization, such as my-org. Leave empty for all

stale_days.title: Stale after (days)
stale_days.description: Your PRs not updated for this many days are listed under Stale

refresh_minutes.title: Refresh interval (minutes)
refresh_minutes.description: How often to fetch PRs from GitHub

summary_model.title: Analysis model
summary_model.description: The model that summarizes review requests and judges risk and release impact. Called when a PR arrives or is updated

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.description: When review requests are sent to the model for analysis: auto (from startup), when opened (once /pr-inbox has been opened in the session) or off

desktop_notify.title: OS notifications
desktop_notify.description: Also raise an OS notification (macOS or Linux) for: review requests (new review requests), all (also approvals, changes requested and CI failures on your PRs) or off. Toasts inside Claude Code always show

language.title: Analysis language
language.description: Language for the AI summary, risk and release impact. auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then LANG. Or a language name such as English or Japanese

explain_prompt.title: Explain prompt
explain_prompt.description: What e asks Claude about a review request. {url} becomes the PR URL. Empty uses the default (purpose, main changes, risks, what to look at). Reading the comments and linked issues, and the read-only rules, are always added

risk_high.title: High risk criteria
risk_high.description: What counts as high risk in the analysis. Empty uses the default (migrations, auth, billing, personal data, deletion, breaking API changes, production config, wide changes without tests)

risk_medium.title: Medium risk criteria
risk_medium.description: What counts as medium risk. Empty uses the default (behavior changes, minor or major dependency upgrades, thinly tested features)

risk_low.title: Low risk criteria
risk_low.description: What counts as low risk. Empty uses the default (docs, tests only, patch upgrades, types, wording or renames)

release_impact.title: Release impact criteria
release_impact.description: How to judge the impact on release (yes, no or unknown). Empty uses the default (visible to end or internal users, feature flags taken into account)

ai_approve.title: AI review: approve
ai_approve.description: What v does when the AI review passes: confirm (ask before approving) or auto (approve without asking, for PRs from members and collaborators of the repository and for Dependabot or Renovate; others are still asked)

review_model.title: AI review: model
review_model.description: The model of the AI review: the reviewer and verifier calls

review_purpose.title: AI review: Purpose & scope
review_purpose.description: Instructions for the reviewer that checks whether the PR achieves its stated purpose and stays as simple as it needs. Empty uses the default; off skips this perspective

review_correctness.title: AI review: Correctness & compatibility
review_correctness.description: Instructions for the reviewer that checks bugs, breaking changes, migrations, rollback and performance. Empty uses the default; off skips this perspective

review_tests.title: AI review: Tests
review_tests.description: Instructions for the reviewer that checks whether tests cover the changed behavior. Empty uses the default; off skips this perspective

review_security.title: AI review: Security & secrets
review_security.description: Instructions for the reviewer that checks security problems and secrets or sensitive data in the diff. Empty uses the default; off skips this perspective

review_conventions.title: AI review: Conventions
review_conventions.description: Instructions for the reviewer that checks the repository's written rules (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, REVIEW.md, CONTRIBUTING.md) and its patterns. Empty uses the default; off skips this perspective

review_dependency_impact.title: AI review: Upgrade impact (dependency PRs)
review_dependency_impact.description: Instructions for the reviewer that checks for Dependabot and Renovate PRs: what changed in each upgraded package, direct or indirect, and whether this repository is affected. Empty uses the default; off skips this perspective

review_supply_chain.title: AI review: Supply chain (dependency PRs)
review_supply_chain.description: Instructions for the reviewer that checks for Dependabot and Renovate PRs: new packages, unexpected registries, typosquats, install scripts. Empty uses the default; off skips this perspective
